approval: Human: 批准锚点收敛强对照
anchor: Existing T0 global temperature, independently replayed from fit subset only; same fixed anchor in every arm. Zero residual recovers T0, not uniform predictions.
parameterization: q=softmax(log(p)/T0 + X_aug Theta); Theta starts at zero in primary fits, explicit lambda/2*||Theta||_F^2 includes intercept. Convex objective, no auxiliary or role-aware loss.

representations.E: E18, four log(p) columns, L: 23 columns
representations.EH_permuted: Same E23; independently permuted H64 within each subset, fit seed 20271002 and stop seed 20281002; no label conditioning

preprocessing: Reuse original fit-only PCA and visual standardization. New P/E representation means and population SD fitted only on gate_stop_projector_fit, floor 1e-8; no stop statistics, no PCA refitting. Explicit p/L are deterministic E18 reparameterizations, not new information.
capacity: All residual coefficients are active, no padding. Raw parameters P=20,E=96,H=260,EH/EH_permuted=352. Identical ridge objective and solver; active dimensions are NOT matched.
checkpoint_criterion: Use final stationary convex fit; no stopping-set checkpoint choice, no regularization sweep, no raw/calibrated-version selection, no post-fit temperature fitting.
restarts: Two predeclared perturbed initializations validate unique-solution numerical stability. Primary result is zero initialization regardless of stop scores; these are not independent random-seed statistical replicates.
scope: Existing Fold 0 caches only. No new image reads, feature extraction, backbone update, new neural architecture, joint loss, outer/Fold1/2 access or formal report edits.

screening.interpretation: Primary EH stopping NLL must beat T0 and primary P/E by >=0.005 and beat primary shuffled-H by >=0.005. Role screen additionally requires new/net target counts and at most one extra Ti/metallic false target versus T0. Descriptive development screens only, no automatic promotion or significance/MI claim.

verification: Register protocol and code in Git before real-cache solver execution. Pin sources, report, caches and preprocessing. Check analytic gradient/Hessian on synthetic data, stationarity and strong-convex gap certificates, all 15 exact fit replays, 32 prediction tables and fit-only preprocessing replay. Keep failure output, no automatic retry or posthoc protocol tuning.
limitations: Repeatedly exposed 340-row stopping subset, small fit sample, fixed PCA64 and lambda, different active capacities. A negative screen does not prove zero conditional information; a positive screen is not independent evidence of a novel role-aware network or industrial performance.
